message:
Now I understand the flow. I need to craft an ICC profile with an `A2B0` tag of type `mft1` or `mft2` where `input_channels > 4`. The `read_mft_common` function will write to `a2b->grid_points[i]` for `i` up to `input_channels-1`, which overflows the 4-element array.

Let me look at the ICC profile format and the tag parsing to understand the structure I need to create. Let me look at how the profile is parsed:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "skcms_Parse\|tag_count\|tag_table\|tag_Layout" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/skcms/src/ICCProfile.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
